lines.text: # VitaDeck

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Consolidate agent build guidance

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
lines.text: VitaDeck runs React-authored **Deck Apps** on a PlayStation Vita. A C host (raylib + QuickJS) renders an instance tree that a custom React reconciler drives; the same host builds for macOS/Linux for development. `@vitadeck/sdk` on npm is how Deck App authors build and package apps.

lines.text: Prefer simple systems and small diffs. Fight scope creep; honor the dev's intent minimally. Leave the repo buildable after every change.

lines.text: ## How it works

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Consolidate agent build guidance

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: build: configure host builds with Ninja
lines.text: `pnpm --dir js build` compiles the SDK, the example Deck Apps (`js/examples/*/dist/*.vdapp`), and the runtime bundle (`js/dist/runtime/runtime.js`). The host CMake build reruns that when files under `js/` change and links `js/dist/runtime` and `assets/` into the build tree; the `stage_examples` target (also run by `run`) copies the examples into `<build>/vitadeck-data/installed-deck-apps`, a plain `cmake --build out` does not. The everyday loop is `ninja -C out run`. At startup `src/core/bootstrap.c` inits raylib, fonts, and the QuickJS runtime, loads the **Active Deck App** from the **Installed Deck App Library**, and the reconciler in `js/packages/runtime` mutates the native instance tree that `src/ui/render.c` paints each frame. `Start`/F1 toggles the **VitaDeck Shell**, which also hosts **Runtime Upload** (HTTP listener on 8787) for installing `.vdapp.zip` archives over LAN.

lines.text: ## Setup

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Consolidate agent build guidance

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: fix(scripts): agent-check runs on the pinned Node and builds JS before tsc
lines.text: - Node.js 24.16+ (`.nvmrc`; `fnm use` picks it up, and `scripts/agent-check.sh` switches to it through fnm on its own) and pnpm (pinned by `packageManager` in `js/package.json`). `pnpm --dir js install` once. Older Node bundles a corepack that cannot launch pnpm 11+ and fails with `Cannot find module .../bin/pnpm.cjs`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
lines.text: - `git submodule update --init --recursive` if `vendor/quickjs/quickjs.c` is missing.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: build: drop the linux preset
lines.text: - Host build needs CMake, Ninja, raylib 5.5, curl, OpenSSL, zlib (`brew install ninja raylib` on macOS; Ninja, raylib + OpenGL/X11 dev packages on Linux). Configure `out/` with `cmake --preset default`. A build directory keeps the generator it was configured with; delete an old Make `out/` before configuring it with a preset.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
lines.text: - Vita build and Linux smoke run in Docker. Start Docker Desktop first.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: fix(fonts): evict atlas pages between frames; Korean fallback with block-gated lazy loads (#100)
lines.text: - The first CMake configure downloads the pinned runtime fonts and Twemoji images ([cmake/fonts.cmake](cmake/fonts.cmake), [cmake/twemoji.cmake](cmake/twemoji.cmake)) into the gitignored `assets/fonts/` and `assets/emoji/`; offline it warns, builds anyway with fallbacks (raylib's built-in font, missing-glyph boxes for CJK and Korean, a fallback glyph for emoji), and the next configure retries.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: ci(release): tag-triggered VPK release and npm trusted publishing (#82)
lines.text: - Uploading a Vita build (`upload_vita`, `upload_vpk`, `run`) reads the Vita's IP from `PSVITAIP` when CMake configures, e.g. `export PSVITAIP=192.168.1.177`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
lines.text: - Without the device, `scripts/vita3k.sh` builds the VPK and runs it in the [Vita3K](https://vita3k.org) emulator (macOS, Windows via Git Bash, Linux) with the example Deck Apps installed. New machine setup (Vita3K, Sony's shader compiler) and controls: [the `vitadeck-emulator` skill](.agents/skills/vitadeck-emulator/SKILL.md). Start is Enter in Vita3K, not F1.

lines.text: ## Footguns

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Consolidate agent build guidance

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: build: one parallel run target, JS as a real dependency
lines.text: 1. **Stale `js/dist`.** The host CMake build reruns `pnpm build` when JS changes; the Vita build packs `js/dist` as it finds it. After any change under `js/`, run `pnpm --dir js build` before a Vita build, or you will debug yesterday's JS on the Vita.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
lines.text: 2. **Two-language package format.** The Deck App Package Manifest is validated natively in `src/core/package_manifest.c` and produced by the SDK CLI. A change to one without the other ships packages the host rejects, or accepts packages the SDK never emits. Update both and the `package_manifest` CTest harness.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: test: press every Pad Button in each example Deck App and switch Deck Apps
lines.text: 3. **Platform goldens.** `tests/fixtures/golden/Linux/` holds the only canonical goldens (ADR 0002). Refresh it only with `scripts/smoke-docker.sh update-golden`, never from a macOS run. Do not re-enable the `smoke` CTest label in the macOS ctest step.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
lines.text: 4. **Secrets in examples.** `js/examples/chat/src/genesys/genesys.local.ts` is gitignored and holds real credentials. Never commit it, never paste its contents, and never "fix" imports by renaming it.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
lines.text: 5. **Running from the wrong cwd.** The host resolves `vitadeck-data/` relative to the working directory (or `VITADECK_DATA_ROOT`). Run `./vitadeck` from `out/`, not the repo root.

lines.text: The common defect is a change that works on the host and breaks the Vita, or works in one example and breaks the SDK contract.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Add Matt Pocock engineering skills and repo agent configuration.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
lines.text: - **Targets.** Host (macOS/Linux) and Vita share `src/`. Anything touching threads, filesystem, networking, or GL belongs behind `src/platform/` or needs a Vita Docker build to prove it.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
lines.text: - **Author contract.** `@vitadeck/sdk` is published. A change to its exports, types, CLI flags, scaffold template, or manifest shape is a breaking change for authors. Bump the Deck App Package Schema Version when the manifest shape changes.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
lines.text: - **Inputs.** Vita buttons and host keyboard mappings (F1 Start, Enter confirm, Backspace back) must stay in sync in `src/ui/input.c` and in `CONTEXT.md`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
lines.text: - **Reverse states.** Upload needs cancel, install needs removal, Shell open needs Shell close. Check the failure paint, not just success.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
lines.text: - **Docs.** If a change makes `CONTEXT.md`, an ADR, the SDK README, or a skill inaccurate, fix it in place. Do not append a second account.

lines.text: ## Notes from Máté

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
lines.text: I want simple C and simple TypeScript solving a real problem: React on a PS Vita. The host is a thin, honest rendering of the instance tree, and the SDK is the only public surface. Keep platform quirks behind `src/platform/`, keep the manifest contract explicit, and prefer deleting machinery over adding it.
